recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If the SNOMED CT property table changes in the future, handle that in THO/HL7 Terminology source; FHIR core needs no follow-up for FHIR-19647.
issue_request: FHIR-19647 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested that normalForm and normalFormTerse either be removed or state that normal form expressions are not suitable for use in subsumption testing.
initial_application: Jira records pre-application in git 2d0ba228f6. That commit updated source/snomedct.html so both SNOMED CT normal form property definitions included the requested subsumption-testing warning.
additional_context: FHIR-35933 later deleted source/snomedct.html as part of moving external code system usage pages from FHIR core to HL7 Terminology/THO. Current core source keeps only the SNOMED CT Usage Summary page and links SNOMED CT usage guidance to https://terminology.hl7.org/SNOMEDCT.html. The current THO English page lists normalForm and normalFormTerse with the FHIR-19647 warning.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No FHIR core source edit is needed because current core no longer owns the old property table and the linked authoritative THO page preserves the resolved clarification.

related_jiras.note: Moved external code system usage pages, including SNOMED CT, out of core and into THO while keeping a core usage-summary link.
